revisions.body: Socrates turns Hippias's admissions into a forced identity: the expert calculator is most capable of speaking falsely about calculation and most capable of speaking truly about it. The contradiction is produced by the assent chain itself, which makes the good calculator no better than the false speaker on this measure.
